uv run python -u -c 
from tasks.t0052_minimal_dsgc_scalar_gaba.code.cell import build_dsgc_from_swc
from tasks.t0052_minimal_dsgc_scalar_gaba.code.constants import V_INIT_MV, DT_MS
from tasks.t0052_minimal_dsgc_scalar_gaba.code.neuron_bootstrap import ensure_neuron_importable, load_stdrun, enable_cvode
from tasks.t0052_minimal_dsgc_scalar_gaba.code.paths import MORPHOLOGY_SWC_PATH
ensure_neuron_importable()
load_stdrun()
from neuron import h
import numpy as np
cell = build_dsgc_from_swc(swc_path=MORPHOLOGY_SWC_PATH)
v_rec = h.Vector(); v_rec.record(cell.soma(0.5)._ref_v)
t_rec = h.Vector(); t_rec.record(h._ref_t)
# Try CVODE
h.cvode.active(True)
h.cvode.atol(1e-3)
h.finitialize(V_INIT_MV)
h.continuerun(500.0)
v = np.array(list(v_rec))
t = np.array(list(t_rec))
print(f'CVODE: V at t={t[-1]:.1f} = {v[-1]:.3f} mV, V at 100={v[np.searchsorted(t,100)]:.3f}, 200={v[np.searchsorted(t,200)]:.3f}, 500={v[-1]:.3f}')
